definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with eye diseases and disorders, or a clinic or department specializing in eye care.

examples.english: I'm going to the eye doctor.

examples.japanese: {目|め}がかゆいので{眼科|がんか}を{受診|じゅしん}した。
examples.english: My eyes were itchy, so I went to an eye clinic.

examples.japanese: コンタクトレンズの{処方箋|しょほうせん}をもらうために{眼科|がんか}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to the ophthalmologist regularly to get my contact lens prescription.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday speech, {眼科|がんか} refers both to the medical specialty and to the clinic itself. {眼科|がんか}に{行|い}く means "to go to the eye doctor/clinic." The doctor is formally called {眼科医|がんかい}.

RELATED MEDICAL DEPARTMENTS:
- {歯科|しか}: dentistry
- {皮膚科|ひふか}: dermatology
- {内科|ないか}: internal medicine
- {外科|げか}: surgery
- {耳鼻科|じびか}: ear, nose, and throat (ENT)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {眼科|がんか}に{行|い}く: to go to the eye clinic
- {眼科|がんか}{検診|けんしん}: eye examination
- {眼科医|がんかい}: ophthalmologist
